text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
And so begins our 'New Year's Special: 
Umamusume to Watch This Year!' Brought to 
you live~.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Our guest today is Mr. C.B.-san, whose 
brilliant performances in the Classic Tier 
are still fresh in our memories~!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeees, Mr. C.B. here. Nice to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
"Man, it's an honor to meet you. I 
actually watched the 'Kikuka Sho' live at 
the track—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After wrapping up the Classic Triple Crown 
route, offers for media appearances 
suddenly skyrocketed.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Phew! I'm exhausted! Sitting around all 
day really doesn't suit me after all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"I accepted because it sounded fun, but 
from now on, I should pick shows where I 
actually get to run—"

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Fans
text_block_list.text: CB-san!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Leaving the TV studio, a group of excited 
young people came running over."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Are they waiting for someone, like 
fans at the stage door?

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry! I just got so excited when I 
realized we were going to meet...!

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Um, I've been following you ever since 
your debut race! Your performance last 
year was amazing!

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan C
text_block_list.text:
I'm rooting for you again this year! 
Surpass that "mythical" girl and prove 
you're the strongest in history!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I'm interested in strength, but 
titles and such don't really interest me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
In a race, you run, have fun, and win. I 
believe that's the absolute best way.

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text:
What?! B-But if it's you, C.B.-san, you 
can definitely do it! I'm rooting for—

text_block_list.name: Security Guard
text_block_list.text: Hey, you guys—!!

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Fans
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, oh crap! Well, see ya! Good luck out 
there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving behind those words, the young fans 
waiting outside vanished into the city in 
the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Impressive. It really seems true that the 
younger generation has high expectations 
of you.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: You remembered!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're the one from summer training 
camp! Are you waiting to see them off too?

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, I just happened to have some work 
here! Sorry for dropping by out of 
nowhere!"

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, look at them. See, told 
you so! They're expecting great things 
from you, C.B.!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: Speaking of which, the same goes for me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, the young man leaned forward 
slightly.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Conquering all classic Senior GⅠs, the 
record for most lifetime wins... CB-san 
can surpass 'myth'! She can become a truly 
special Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
We're seriously cheering for you! With 
everything we've got, always!

text_block_list.name: Young Brown-haired Man
text_block_list.text:
"—Well, I've got to get going! Thanks for 
having me!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... That was intense.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Either way, people are expecting a lot 
from us, huh?
choice_data_list: Should I tell them to hold back?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No, people are free to dream and have 
expectations. I don't want to get in the 
way of that.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I just run freely. That's all that 
matters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, she was saying 
something similar during the summer 
training camp too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, I don't care at all. I'm 
just gonna run however I want!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She must firmly believe that a race is a 
place where one should run freely."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Since we were already out, we decided to 
take a stroll through town to enjoy the 
New Year's atmosphere."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what should we do? Shall we try 
doing the same thing as last year?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I propose, you choose! ...Let's make this 
a special New Year's tradition.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"And so, let's see now~. New Year's, 
huh..."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Option 1: Buy a kotatsu and chill out. 
Option 2: Make some New Year's feast 
dishes since we're here. Option 3: Go pay 
a shrine visit. Now, pick one!
choice_data_list: Buy a kotatsu and chill out

Making osechi, since it's the season for 
it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice! Let's put it in the Trainer's 
room. I was just thinking it was a bit 
chilly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we headed to the shopping district 
to look for a kotatsu.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh, there are so many different types. 
Big ones, small ones, different dough 
thicknesses too...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ah, look! Wouldn't this be great!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Mr. C.B. was pointing at after saying 
that was—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: A hammock!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, another hammock was added to the 
Trainer's Room.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we welcomed another new year. I 
want to keep doing our best together for 
another year!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, nice! Let's try making some New 
Year's dishes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we decided to cook at her place.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Umm, chestnut paste, huh. There are no 
chestnuts, so... let's use mandarins!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Let's use frozen fried shrimp for the 
shrimp. Mom left some for me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "What was next again? Umm..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the making of some truly creative 
osechi began――

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
All right, all done! Fried shrimp, 
tamagoyaki, mikan, curry, Neapolitan, and 
pancakes!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
This osechi lets you enjoy all kinds of 
flavors. Thank you for the food!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, the two of us savored the 
delightfully free-spirited and original 
New Year's feast.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we welcomed another new year. I 
want to keep doing our best together for 
another year!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sounds good. I was just thinking I'd 
like to make a wish for the Senior Class 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we made our way to a nearby 
shrine――

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
choice_data_list: (I hope Mr. C.B. can enjoy the race)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Finished praying at the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: “—Oh, right. I should go buy a charm.”
choice_data_list: Is there something you want to buy?
Is there something you want to buy?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Health charms for Mom and Dad. And the 
same one for Trainer, too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'd be in trouble if you didn't stay 
healthy, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Especially this year, Rudolf is entering 
too. We both have to be in top form.
choice_data_list: Then I'll buy yours for you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you mean a trade? Oh, that sounds 
great. Let's do that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we welcomed another new year. I 
want to keep doing our best together for 
another year!
